From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightpath.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

I signed up through the demo form this morning — thanks for the quick touchpoint. A bit about us: BrightPath Health is building a clinician-facing search over clinical notes and care plans. We're evaluating solutions for embeddings + retrieval + low-latency ranking.

Quick qualification details to help scope the call:
- Primary use case: semantic search + relevance tuning for clinician queries
- Approx data volume: 100k documents (~10M tokens) now, expecting to double in 6 months
- Query volume: ~6k queries/day, peak concurrent sessions ~25
- Timeline: pilot in Q3, production targeted by end of Q4

Would love a 30-minute demo to see product fit and to ask about latency/cost expectations and private deployment options. My availability this week is Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product, BrightPath Health
samir.khan@brightpath.health
Office: (415) 555-0123

Attachment: brightpath_prod_overview.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

Hi Samir — great to meet you and thanks for the details. Happy to set up a 30-minute demo. A few questions to make the demo most useful for you and the team:

1) Which model family are you most interested in (open-source Llama/RedPajama, fine-tuned foundation models, or do you need Redwood-managed models)?
2) Any hard latency SLO per query (p50/p90 targets) we should demo against?
3) Is PHI present in the data? If so, do you need private deployment (VPC/on-prem) details?
4) Who from your team will join the call (engineering, infra, security)?

I'm available for a demo Tue Jul 14 at 10:00 AM PT, or Wed Jul 15 at 9:30 AM PT. If those don't work, here's a quick scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30m?ref=BP-7832

I'll send a short pre-demo questionnaire (quick doc) that helps our solutions engineer tailor examples.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Cell: (650) 555-0199

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below:

- PHI: yes, notes contain PHI — we'd want to discuss VPC/private deployment options and KMS integration.
- Attendees: me (product), Laura Gomez (eng manager), and possibly one infra/security engineer if the time works.

Jul 14 at 10:00 AM PT works for us. Please send the invite and the pre-demo questionnaire.

Samir
